description_for_human: REST fallback for Signal Foundry governed workflow actions.
description_for_model: Use the Signal Foundry API fallback when the MCP action path is unavailable. It exposes the same governed capability registry, risk review, approval, release, release packet, map, and audit activity operations. Writes require explicit user confirmation, idempotencyKey, tenant/project scope, and authenticated actor context.
